##### webhooks.yml

##### workspace.yml
GET https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces  q[roles] body=- -> 200:[WorkspaceDtoV1]  // Get all my workspaces

GET https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}  q[] body=- -> 200:WorkspaceDtoV1  // Get workspace info
PUT https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/cost-rate  q[] body=CostRateRequestV1 -> 200:WorkspaceDtoV1  // Update workspace cost rate
PUT https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/hourly-rate  q[] body=RateWithCurrencyRequestV1 -> 200:WorkspaceDtoV1  // Update workspace billable rate
POST https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/users  q[send-email*] body=AddUserToWorkspaceRequest -> 200:WorkspaceDtoV1  // Add user to a workspace
PUT https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/users/{userId}  q[] body=UpdateUserStatusRequest -> 200:WorkspaceDtoV1  // Update a user's status
PUT https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/users/{userId}/cost-rate  q[] body=CostRateRequestV1 -> 200:WorkspaceDtoV1  // Update a user's cost rate
PUT https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/users/{userId}/hourly-rate  q[] body=HourlyRateRequestV1 -> 200:WorkspaceDtoV1  // Update a user's hourly rate
